parsed.name: RIGOL DS4043数字示波器
parsed.description: 一款通过 VISA/SCPI 控制的台式数字示波器，用于采集和读取一个或多个通道的波形数据。该驱动显示其支持触发、时基、平均采样和原始波形读取，适合实验中的电信号时域观测与波形记录。
parsed.description_en: A bench digital oscilloscope controlled via VISA/SCPI for acquiring and reading waveform data from one or more channels. The driver evidence shows support for trigger setup, timebase configuration, averaging, and raw waveform readout, making it suitable for time-domain electrical signal observation and waveform capture in laboratory experiments.

actions.description: 读取多个示波器通道的波形数据，并按时间轴与电压缩放关系返回采样结果。
actions.description_en: Read waveform data from multiple oscilloscope channels and return the sampled results with time-axis and voltage scaling applied.

actions.description: 配置触发、时基和平均采样后，从指定通道读取原始波形数据。
actions.description_en: Configure trigger, timebase, and averaging, then read raw waveform data from the specified channel.
